Commentary.Commentary: There isn't much on the pitch but a struggling Aussie batting line-up against a pumped up Protea attack is a different proposition. They will have to take it hour by hour and bat solidly and big. Stay tuned.

Hazlewood managed to pick up 6 wickets but they came a session too late. Australia would have loved it if he had supported Starc on Day 1 in a better manner. The latter, on the other hand, brought the Aussies into contention with a 3-wicket burst but this morning he was totally off colour. Lyon seems to have totally lost his confidence while Joe Mennie did not bowl well either.

A massive lead has been mustered by the Proteas. They did not start off well though, losing 4 wickets quickly but Amla, de Kock and Bavuma batted with responsibility and prevented Australia from coming back into the game. The trio lifted South Africa from 76/4 to 276/6, adding 200 runs for the loss of just 2 wickets. Philander's cameo at the end did help but then, the damage was already done.

So Australia have wrapped the innings up in 8.5 overs after Lunch to get some momentum going in their favour. After toiling hard for 150 minutes in the morning session, Hazlewood finally struck the right chord and picked up 3 out of the 4 wickets in the second session.

OUT! Hazlewood finishes with 6/89! Hurls it fuller outside off, pitches and moves away a touch, Philander goes for the drive but gets an outside edge that carries nicely to the keeper who takes the catch. Hazlewood would be happy with his effort. He leads his team off the field. SOUTH AFRICA ARE ALL OUT FOR 326, LEAD BY 241 RUNS!

FOUR! More runs for South Africa! A touch short outside off, Philander cuts it towards Starc at gully who looks to field that one but the ball bursts through his hands and runs down to the third man fence.
Good length on off, Philander defends it.
Philander drives this one back down the wicket.
Joe Burns goes to deep mid-wicket. Australia are happy to give Philander a single to have a bowl at Rabada.
Good length on off, Rabada tucks it towards square leg for a single.
Outside off on a fuller length, Philander takes his bottom hand off that one and punches it to covers.
FOUR! Philander is frustrating Australia here! Sprays it full and wide outside off, Philander gets low and hammers it through covers for a boundary. Smith is a bit flabbergasted.
Full outside off, Philander drives it nicely towards mid off.
Fuller outside off, Philander goes for anothe expansive drive. He gets it towards mid on of the inner half of the bat.
On a length on off, Phiander defends it back.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Starc begins with a nothing delivery, it is short and wide, asking to be hit, Philander obliges and hits it through covers for a boundary.
Starc is called back on to wrap this up.
Fuller outside off, Rabada drives it nicely towards mid off.
Good cricket! Philander taps it towards covers from his crease and takes off for a quick single. The fielder is a bit deep and they complete the single easily.
FOUR! Nicely done! Shorter outside off, Philander gets on top of it and pulls it hard through mid-wicket for a boundary. That was superbly done by Philander.
Good length outside off, Philander defends it towards covers.
Fuller outside off, Philander drives it back to the bowler.
FOUR! EDGED! Outside off on a length, Philander pokes at it and gets an outside edge. The ball runs down to the third man fence for a boundary.
Hurls it outside off on a good length, Rabada is right forward in defense.
Good length outside off, Rabada stands tall and defends it.
Fuller outside off, Rabada drives it towards mid off who dives and tumbles to stop it.
FOUR! Class from Rabada! A touch short outside off, Rabada stays back and punches it through backward point for a boundary. Superb stuff!
Good length on off, Rabada tucks it towards mid on off his crease.
Fuller on off and middle, Philander gets across a touch and clips it through wide mid on. Ferguson gives it a chase from mid on and saves a run for his side. 300 up for South Africa!
Shorter outside off, Rabada drops his wrists and lets it go through safely.
Slanted across on a length, no shot offered by Rabada.
Outside off on a length, Rabada defends it back.
Good length outside off, left alone by Rabada.
Kagiso Rabada is the new man in.

OUT! Five for Hazlewood as Abbott reviews in vain! Bowls it on off and middle, comes in a long way, Abbott comes forward and defends it with his bat and pad together. The players go up in an appeal and the umpire upholds it. Abbott looks to walk off at first but then reviews it. The replays confirm there was no bat there. Ball Tracker shows it was clipping the leg stump and hence the on-field call stays. Hazlewood has five, his fourth in Tests!
Kyle Abbott has been adjudged LBW! He has taken the review though...
Good length outside off, Abbott plays at it from his crease and is beaten.
Outside off on a length, Philander defends it towards mid-wicket off the inner half of the bat.
Angled on a length on middle, Philander looks to work it through mid-wicket but is hit on his thigh pad.
Slants it fuller on middle, Abbott clips it through mid-wicket. Ferguson gives it a chase and saves a run for his side.
Joe Burns comes in at short leg.
Fuller outside off, Abbott comes forward and pushes it to covers.
Fuller outside off, Abbott comes forward and defends it.
Woah! Outside off on a length, comes in, Philander looks to leave it. The ball nips in and goes off the bottom edge past the stumps down to fine leg for a single.
Outside off on a length, Abbott pushes at it from his crease but is beaten all ends up.
On a length outside off, Abbott comes forward and defends it.
This time Abbott leaves it all alone.
Good length outside off, Abbott punches it through point for a boundary but only in his mind as the ball moves away and is beaten all ends up.
Kyle Abbott is the new man in.

OUT! TIMBER! Bowls it outside off, comes in sharply, Maharaj plays all over it and is bowled as the ball hits the top of middle. Josh is all smiles and why not, South Africa are losing wickets in a flurry here.
Length ball outside off, Maharaj ducks under it. Not sure if Maharaj picked it.
Angled it on middle and leg, Maharaj works it down to fine leg for a single to get off the mark.
Outside off, left alone this time.
Wow. It has become bright and sunny. And we thought only English weather is unpredictable, eh?
Bowls it outside off, Maharaj is beaten as he plays at it.
KESHAV MAHARAJ walks in to bat.

OUT! Extra bounce gets the better of Bavuma and Joe Mennie has his maiden Test wicket! Bowls it on around off, Bavuma looks to work it through the leg side but the ball bounces a bit more and he is caught early into his shot. The ball lobs off the leading edge towards point where Lyon pouches it safely. The Australians are delighted for Mennie! Bavuma at the other hand is gutted on not carrying on after working so hard.
It has started to drizzle again. Not looking too heavy but the umpires are concerned. Play continues though...
Fuller outside off, Bavuma comes forward and defends it.
Good length outside off, Bavuma stands tall and defends it.
Joe Mennie to bowl from the other end. Hazlewood was holding his right hand, seems to have hurt his elbow.
Fuller and angling in, Philander drives it nicely but too straight. Hazlewood goes low to his right and stops it in his followthrough and Bavuma gets back in time at the non-striker's end.
Good length outside off, Philander defends it off the outer half of the bat towards gully.
Angled on a length outside off, Philander presents the full face of the bat and pushes it towards mid on.
Fuller again on off, comes in, Philander clips it nicely but straight to Burns at mid-wicket.
Good length outside off, Philander stays back and defends it.
FOUR! Poor ball to start! Begins with a fuller length ball on the pads, Philander is more than happy to clip it through mid-wicket for a boundary. Not a good start for Australia!
The players are out in the middle. TEMBA BAVUMA and VERNON PHILANDER are out in the middle. JOSH HAZLEWOOD to begin the session.
0745 IST - As expected, the rain has stopped. We should be starting soon. The sun is out, play will resume at 0800 IST.
0740 IST - Some bad news! The drizzle that was around has gotten heavier and the covers are on the pitch. Shouldn't be a long delay though.
It will be interesting to see how Australia bowl at the tail, South Africa will aim to add as many as possible before having a crack at the Australians. Let's see how things pan out.
Day 3... Session 2...

Steven Smith tried out everything but nothing worked for Australia. Yes there were balls beating the outside edges but those were not backed up well enough. The Australian bowlers failed to exert enough pressure to induce more false strokes. The lead is already past 200 and things are really looking like the weather on day 2 for Australia - very gloomy. They will need to take wickets in a flurry to stage a comeback in the game with the bat in their second innings. South Africa on the other hand, will want to bat as long as possible and ensure they do not have to bat again in the Test. Do join us in a while for the second session.

South Africa continue to dominate the proceedings. They have added 117 runs in the session losing just the wicket of de Kock. And there could not have been more contrasting styles on show. Bavuma was happy to play the patient game after a shaky start while de Kock took the attack to the hosts. The latter brought up his 2nd Test ton but fell soon after it to Hazlewood - the only thing that worked in favour of Australia.

First proper shot hit by Bavuma down the ground, this innings! Fuller in length and around off, Temba Bavuma leans into it and drives it down the ground towards mid off and gets another couple. THAT WILL ALSO BE LUNCH ON DAY 3!

In the air... falls short! Fuller in length and angling in, Bavuma tries to drive it down the ground but ends up chipping it in the air towards mid on. Ferguson dives to his left to take that one but the ball falls just short of him. The ball then goes through and the batsmen take a couple. The lead goes past 200 now!
Back of a length ball on off, Temba takes his bottom hand and plays it towards gully.
Good length ball on off, pushed towards the fielder at point.
Touch full and around off, Bavuma plays this one with soft hands towards gully.
Good length delivery on off, coming in with the angle. Bavuma leaves it alone.

Fuller in length and wide outside off, Bavuma comes forward and drives it past the diving Lyon at cover-point. The ball slows down and the fielder from point goes for the chase. He does really well to try and scoop the ball back in play. They refer it upstairs to see if there was any contact made when the ball was in the hand. No says the TV umpire, three runs added to the tally.
Back of a length ball on middle, Bavuma pulls it through mid-wicket and comes back for a double.
On a length and around off, Bavuma plays it towards point.
Josh hits the deck hard but down the leg side. Bavuma goes for the pull but fails to put any bat on it.
Good length delivery on off, punched towards the off side.

That's a risky stroke to play! Fuller and angling in on the pads, Philander walks across a long way and still manages to flick. Gets it through mid-wicket but the soggy outfield means it won't cross the ropes but they get three.
Outside off, it's been left alone.
Bavuma gets back and tucks this length delivery towards the leg side.
In the channel outside off, Bavuma shoulders his arms to that one.
TB drives it towards mid on.
Fuller in length and angling in, worked towards mid-wicket.

NOT OUT! The decision stays as it is. Angles in a length delivery from around off, comes back in as well. Bavuma looks to flick it across the line but misses and is hit on the back pad. A loud appeal follows but the umpire stays unmoved. Smith takes the referral and replays show that the impact is outside off. Australia lose both their reviews now.
An LBW decision against Bavuma is referred upstairs. It looks really close.
Back of a length delivery on off, Vernon looks to defend but misses as the ball goes off the outside edge to the keeper.
Good length ball on off, Philander defends it down.
VERNON PHILANDER is the new man in.

OUT! Bowled 'em! I think I have jinxed him. Josh Hazlewood finally gets a breakthrough as the 144-run stand has been broken. He hurls it on a length on off, gets it to nip back in sharply as de Kock tries to drive it away from the body and that does him in. The ball goes through his defense and shatters the off pole behind. Quinton is gutted at himself as he starts to make a long walk to the pavilion. End of a superb stand for South Africa!

FOUR! That's flayed! Back of a length ball on off, de Kock stands tall and cuts it behind point for a boundary. This is not a good sign for the Aussies, if he starts to unleash, he will be unstoppable.
Gets behind the line and defends it down.
Fuller in length and around off, pushed towards covers for nothing.
Hazlewood back on for a bowl.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
2nd Test ton for Quinton de Kock!

There it is, a ton for Quinton! Length ball on middle and leg, tucked towards square leg for an easy single. What a knock this has been from de Kock. The entire South Africa dressing room stands and applauds, de Kock just removes his helmet and acknowledges the attention. Remember, he has an injury on his left wrist but still has played a knock to remember.
Fuller in length and around off, de Kock defends it off the front foot.

FOUR! Oh, that's whipped! This reminds me of Virat Kohli who is just too good when the bottom hand comes into play. Fuller in length and angling in on middle and leg, de Kock gets across and whips it through mid-wicket for a boundary. No need to run for those and Quinton is just one short of a deserving ton here.
Fuller and tailing back in sharply, de Kock flicks it nicely but finds short mid-wicket in place.
On a length and moves away slightly, de Kock pushes it towards covers.
Length ball on middle and leg, tucked towards the leg side.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

Banged in short on middle and leg, Bavuma hops and tries to fend it away on the leg side but the ball bounces off the deck, goes off the gloves towards backward square leg. Bavuma runs the first one hard and is too quick to and gets back for the second before the ball could come to the keeper.
Short and served wide outside off, at 145.3 kph, Bavuma leaves it alone.
Good length delivery on middle and off, Bavuma once again offers a nice defense.
Angles in a length ball on middle, Bavuma defends it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Keeps it nice and full and around off, driven towards the man at mid off.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Fuller and angling in, nudged through the leg side for a brace.
Fuller in length and around off, driven towards mid off.
Back of a length ball on the pads, clipped through square leg for a couple.

FOUR! Back of a length delivery on middle, de Kock swivels a bit and then pulls it in front of square. The fielder at short mid-wicket dives to his left to stop it but the ball goes through for a boundary. So, back-to-back boundaries for SA.
Floodlights have been turned on now and there is slight drizzle in the air as well. Showers are predicted later in the day but looks like the rain doesn't want to wait that long...
FOUR! Crisp! An overpitched delivery on off, Bavuma leans into it and drives it excellently through covers for a boundary to end the over.
Bavuma chases a very wide delivery outside off and fails to get any bat on it.
Fuller in length and angling away, Temba defends it down.
Back of a length ball on off, Bavuma punches it through covers and comes back for a double.

Superb stop from Lyon! Fuller in length and served wide outside off, Bavuma goes for the drive through the off side. Gets a good connection but Lyon at cover-point dives to his right to prevent a certain boundary.
Good length ball on middle, Bavuma stays put and defends it down.

FOUR! Warner doesn't dive and my colleague erupts saying - "If he doesn't dive, it means he has also given up!" Fuller in length and outside off, de Kock leans into it and drives it just past mid off. Warner doesn't dive and the ball goes through. He gives it a chase and then puts in a dive to try and scoop the ball back but to no avail.
Good length ball outside off, defended from within the crease.
Pitches it up on off, Quinton pushes this straight to Warner at mid off.
Fuller in length and outside off, de Kock drives it through the gap at covers for a couple of runs.
Fuller in length and around off, driven off the inner part of the bat towards mid on.
Fuller in length and angling in, it's pushed back to the bowler.
Good length ball close to the off stump line, Temba gets behind the line and defends it down.
Very full and nipping back in sharply. de Kock jams it out towards the on side for a single.
Good length ball on off, punched off the inner part of the bat towards covers.
Touch short and outside off, QDK cuts it straight to the man at point.
Fuller in length and around off, pushed towards the off side.
Angles in a length ball, moves through the surface as de Kock is late in his flick and gets hit on the pads.
Fuller and angling in, Temba defends it down into the ground.

NOT OUT! No bat involved! Hazlewood fires in a full ball on off, moves away a touch. Bavuma looks to dig it out but misses as the ball goes into the keeper's gloves. There was some noise for sure and that made the Aussies go up in an appeal for a caught behind. Umpire Kettleborough turns it down but Smith takes the review. Replays show there is no wood involved and the sound was of the bat hitting the turf.
There was some noise as the ball went past the outside edge to the keeper. The on-field umpire says not out but the Aussies have taken a review against Bavuma.
Fuller and shapes away a touch after pitching. Bavuma doesn't even look at it.
Fuller in length and outside off, driven towards the man at mid off.
Good length delivery on off, Temba once again lets it go.
On a length and outside off, Temba shoulders his arms to that one. Nice carry through to the keeper.
Josh Hazlewood is back on to bowl.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
Good length ball on off, defended with an opened face bat to point.

Fuller in length and angling in, de Kock bunts it down the ground as Starc tries to stop it with his left boot but fails to do so. The ball hits the timber at the other end and deflects towards mid on. Temba made it in and so even if it kissed the boot of Starc, he was save.
Angles in a length ball on middle and leg, tucked towards the leg side.
Fuller and dipping in, Quinton jams it out towards mid on.
Wrong line to start with! Comes steaming in and hurls in on the pads, de Kock looks to flick but misses as the ball brushes his pads and runs down to fine leg. A couple of leg byes picked up.
STARC comes back for a bowl with the second new nut.
The second new ball is available and TAKEN immediately.
Gets behind the line and offers a straight bat defense.
Pushed past the man at covers for an easy single.
Just past short leg! Tossed up ball around middle, Bavuma gets back to flick but is lucky as the ball goes just past the left of the short leg fielder to the deep. A single taken.
Outside off, coming in, Temba is happy to defend it down into the ground.
Flatter through the air around middle, tucked through square leg for one.
Full and around off, de Kock makes room and drives it straight to short extra cover.
Floated ball around middle, Bavuma looks to drive it down the ground but gets it off the inner part of the bat to the bowler.
Comes from around the wicket and bowls a loopy delivery around middle, it's flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy ball around middle, de Kock looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads.
Around off, it's kept out well by QDK.
FOUR! Swept away in style! Smith serves a nice low full toss on the pads, Quinton gets down on one knee and sweeps it through square leg for a boundary all the way.
Tossed up ball around off, de Kock defends it on the off side.
The skipper Steven Smith has brought himself into the attack now...
Full and around middle and off, Bavuma once again comes forward and defends it solidly.
Loopy ball, zipping through the surface as Bavuma clips it past short leg and calls for a single. Square leg fielder gets to the ball and that denies them a single.
Around off, turning in, Bavuma covers the line and defends it.
Makes a good stride forward and defends it gently.
Tossed up delivery around off, pushed towards covers off the front foot.
Drops it short and around off, QDK camps back and punches it past Voges at extra cover for a single.
Angles in a length ball on the pads, clipped towards the leg side for nothing.
Gets behind the line and offers a straight bat defense.
Good length ball on off, Temba defends it from within the crease.
Touch short and around off, Bavuma comes forward and pushes it with soft hands towards gully.
Fuller in length and just outside off, defended off the front foot.
Fuller and angling in, flicked straight to the man at short mid-wicket.
Around middle and off, kept out in time.

STUMPING CHANCE MISSED! Loopy ball around off, turns in a bit as de Kock looks to come down the track and drive it over extra cover. Misses it completely and Nevill behind the stumps fails to collect it cleanly. Much to de Kock's delight the ball though in spite of bursting off the gloves doesn't deflect onto the stumps.
Loopy around middle and off, de Kock comes forward and blocks it out.
Tossed up ball around off, defended off the front foot gently.
Similar ball and similar shot, just like the previous ball.
Short and outside off, de Kock camps back and cuts it straight to the man at short extra cover.
DRINKS!
Good length outside off, Bavuma pushes it towards covers.
Angled on a fuller length on middle, Bavuma pushes it towards mid on.
Back of a length outside off, Bavuma tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Good length outside off, Bavuma defends it towards gully.
Angled on a fuller length on off, Bavuma keeps it out.
Fuller outside off, Bavuma pushes it back down the wicket.
Floated on off, de Kock comes forward and defends it.
Goes back and cuts it towards point.
Shorter outside off, Lyon cuts it towards point.
Silly mid on comes in place now...
100-run stand between de Kock and Bavuma!

FOUR! Poor bowling, this! Slips out a full toss on the pads, de Kock is more than happy to clip it through mid-wicket for a boundary. Lyon needs to be patient and bowl in the right channel and not worry about getting hit for the boundaries.
Goes back and works it towards mid-wicket off his crease.
Bowled on middle, de Kock comes down a long way and pads it away with his bat and pad together. Smith is only one appealing long and hard.
Soft hands! Bowls it around off, Bavuma has to play at it and he does so with the softest of hands to ensure that the edge does not carry to the second slip.
Angled in on a length on off, Bavuma defends it from his crease.
de Kock works it towards square leg for a single.
Fuller outside off, de Kock places it towards covers.
FOUR! DEFT! A touch short outside off, de Kock camps back and places it past the gully fielder for a boundary. That raced away to the fence.
Fuller outside off, de Kock comes forward and plays it back down the wicket.
Floated on off, de Kock comes down and pushes it to deep mid off for a single.
Floated outside off, Bavuma looks to defend but gets it off the outer half towards third man for a single.
Works it through mid on for a single.
Full outside off, de Kock pushes it to covers.
de Kock comes forward and pushes it to covers.
FOUR! Up and over! Floated outside off, de Kock comes forward and drives up and over extra cover for a boundary. He is clearly targeting Lyon here.
Fuller length on off, Bavuma pushes it towards mid on from his crease.
On a length on middle, Bavuma defends it towards the on side.
Full outside off, pushed wide of Warner at mid off for a single.
Full on off, de Kock looks to clip it through but is hit on his front pad off the inside edge.
Hurls it outside off on a length, de Kock lets it go through.
Outside off on a length, de Kock comes forward and defends it.
Mennie comes on for a bowl.
Floated outside off, Bavuma comes forward and defends it.
Bavuma gets across and looks to paddle it down to short fine leg but not for any runs.
Bavuma looks to hit at first but then drives it through covers. No runs taken.
Floated outside off, Bavuma lets it go through.
FOUR! Poor ball, hit away! Shorter outside off, Bavuma goes back and cuts it through point for a boundary.
Floated outside off, Bavuma gets across and defends it.
Fuller outside off, de Kock comes forward and drives it towards mid off. That went off the inner half of the bat.
The sun is out for a change!
Good length on off, de Kock comes forward and taps it towards mid-wicket.
Outside off, de Kock comes forward and pushes it to covers.
Back of a length on middle, Bavuma works it through square leg for a single.
Fuller outside off, Bavuma comes forward and drives it towards mid off.
Outside off, another leave from Bavuma.
FOUR! Tonk! de Kock is going after Lyon here! Comes down the wicket and slams it up and over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Floated on off, de Kock comes forward and defends it.
The cover fielder goes back. They want de Kock to go for the cut.
Short again, de Kock cuts it off the stumps towards covers.
Shorter on middle, de Kock goes back and cuts it towards covers.
7th Test fifty for Quinton de Kock!
FOUR! Fifty! Floated on middle, de Kock gets under it and clobbers it through mid-wicket for a boundary. He gets to his fifty in style.
Fuller on middle, de Kock turns it towards mid on.
Nathan Lyon comes on for a bowl. A slip and a short leg in place.
Full outside off, Bavuma is happy to let it through. Hazlewood is rattled a touch.
Angled on a good length outside off, Bavuma defends it towards covers.
The umpire is having a look at the ball. The ball is going through the 8-shape gauge and it is handed back to the bowler.
Fuller outside off, left alone by Bavuma.
Pitched up on off, Bavuma defends it towards mid-wicket off the inner half of the bat.
Fuller outside off, Bavuma shoulders his arms to it.
Good length outside off, de Kock works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Pitched up on off, Bavuma presents the full face of the bat and times his push towards mid on.
Outside off, Bavuma defends it from his crease.
Bavuma comes forward and turns it towards mid-wicket.
Bavuma is not quite middling them right now! On a length on the stumps, Bavuma pushes it in the air towards mid on off his crease.

Poor throw! Angled on a fuller length outside off, de Kock drives it towards mid off and takes off for a single. He makes to his crease as Ferguson is a touch late and has a shy which is wide of the stumps at the non-striker's end.
On a length outside off, de Kock works it towards mid-wicket. Warner goes to his left from mid on and stops it.
Fuller length on off, Bavuma is right forward to defend it.
4th Test fifty for Temba Bavuma!
FIFTY! Full outside off, Bavuma looks to drive it through covers. He takes the bottom hand off but the ball still goes off the outside edge through gully for a couple of runs. Brings up his fifty.
Just over the stumps! Good length outside off, comes in, Bavuma defends it but the ball goes back and bounces just over the stumps. No luck yet for Australia!
Banged in short on middle, de Kock controls his pull through square leg for a single.
Bowls it outside off, de Kock presses forward and defends it.
On a length on off, de Kock defends it from his crease.
Change of ends for Hazlewood.
Just short! Outside off on a length, Bavuma looks for the drive on the up but mistimes it towards mid off. Warner stationed there did go to his left but it fell way short of him.
Pitched up on off, Bavuma drives it towards mid off where the fielder dives and stops the ball.
Good length outside off, Bavuma lets it pass.
Angled in on a fuller length on off, Bavuma pushes it nicely towards mid on off the crease.
Good length outside off, left alone by Bavuma again.
Fuller outside off, left alone by Bavuma.
FOUR! All timing! Fuller on off, de Kock comes forward and clips it through wide mid on for a boundary.
Outside off on a length, de Kock presses forward and defends it.
Turns this one towards the on side.

It is very cold and the players have had troubles keeping their hands warm. The Australians have a pack in their pockets, which ensures there hands stays warm and no wonder when not needed, all the Australian hands when not in use are inside the pockets. Poor Peter Nevill though. In between, Lyon is shown warming up.
On a length on off, de Kock comes forward and plays it back down the wicket.
Shortish outside off, de Kock plays it towards point from his crease.
On a length on off, de Kock looks to drive but gets it towards mid on off the inner half. He looks for a single but is sent back.
On the body, on a length, works it behind square leg for a couple of runs.
Full outside off, Bavuma creams it off the middle of the bat but finds the fielder at cover. That was superbly hit.
Angled on a fuller length, Bavuma comes forward and defends it.
JUST SHORT! Fuller on off, Bavuma goes for the drive but gets it off the edge. The ball drops short of Starc at gully. Smith has his hands on his head.
Bowls it outside off on a length, comes in  touch, Bavuma lets it go through.
Outside off on a fuller length, Bavuma pushes it towards covers.
JOE MENNIE to bowl now.
Fuller on off, de Kock digs it out back to the bowler who mimes the throw.
Good length outside off, de Kock defends it off his crease.
Fuller outside off, Bavuma drives it towards extra cover. Warner goes to his left and stops it. A single taken though.
Outside off on a length, left alone.
Kevin Pietersen on air informs that de Kock had bruised his left thumb before the Test, so it could be what is troubling him.
Fuller outside off, Bavuma comes forward and defends it.
Outside off on a length, Bavuma stays in his crease and pushes it towards gully off his crease.
FOUR! Streaky! A touch short on off, not enough room to cut but de Kock goes for it and manages to dab it through the gap between the slips and gully for a boundary.
Good length outside off, de Kock defends it off his crease with his angled bat.
Landed outside off, de Kock is right forward to defend it.
Good length outside off, de Kock lets it go through. He is flinching in some pain. He was hit on his bottom hand and it seems to be bothering him a bit. South Africa will hope he is fine.
This time de Kock covers the line and defends it to covers.
Outside off on a length, de Kock presses forward to defend but is beaten all ends up.
Nice carry! Pitched up outside off, Bavuma this time is happy to leave it. Good call too since that one carried nicely through to the keeper.
Good length outside off, Bavuma defends it off his crease with an angled bat towards gully.
BEATEN! Fuller outside off, Bavuma this time goes for the drive from his crease but is beaten all ends up.
Outside off, Bavuma drives it through covers for a couple of runs.
Goes round the wicket, de Kock fends it off the bottom hand towards square leg for a single. That seems to have hurt him a touch.
50-run stand up between Bavuma and de Kock!
FOUR! Indecision! de Kock wishes to play at this good length ball outside off but looks to withdraw his bat late. It goes off the face of the bat through gully for a boundary.
Pitched up on off, Bavuma comes forward and defends it.
FOUR! Neat! Fuller on middle, Bavuma clips it through mid-wicket for a boundary. There was a short mid-wicket in place but it went wide of him. Joe Burns was the fielder there.
Length ball on middle, Bavuma is opened up a touch but he opens the face of the bat to defend it to covers.
Good ball! Angled on a length outside off, Bavuma has to play at it but the angle and the slight movement ensures there is no outside edge.
Fuller in length on off, Bavuma pushes it towards mid on off the inner half.
On a length outside off, Bavuma is happy to let it go.
Good length on middle, Bavuma defends it off the inner half through square leg for a run. Bavuma wanted the second but he slipped while completing the first one.
Fuller on off, Bavuma pushes it towards covers. That was a nice shot but the bat turned in his hands as he played that.
Fuller outside off, left alone by Bavuma.
Bowls it down the leg side, Bavuma looks to clip it but is beaten all ends up.
Angled on the body, Bavuma gets in line and turns it towards mid-wicket off his crease.
Slanted across off, Bavuma lets it go through.
MITCHELL STARC to bowl from the other end. Three slips in place for him.

FOUR! Nice shot! Fuller outside off, similar to the first ball but this was a bit wide and this time de Kock gets nicely over it and clips it crisply through the gap between mid-wicket and mid on for a boundary to get going.
Slanted across outside off, de Kock is happy to let it go.
Fuller outside off, de Kock pushes it back down the wicket off the inner half.
Good length on off, de Kock stays back and defends it.
Left alone by de Kock.

Drama to begin! Fuller in length on leg stump, de Kock looks to clip it through mid-wicket but misses and is rapped on the pads. The bowler turns around for an appeal but the umpire says no. That looked like it pitched outside leg to the naked eye.

Game time! The players are out in the middle. QUINTON DE KOCK and TEMBA BAVUMA are out to bat for South Africa. Australia are attacking as they should with two slips and a gully for JOSH HAZLEWOOD! Here we go....

South Africa have a lead of 86 runs and will know a fine partnership here between Quinton de Kock and Temba Bavuma could really put them further on top. Australia will want to restrict them as much as possible. The first session will be pivotal to their chances of staging a comeback. It promises to be a fine battle. Stay tuned for all the action.

Hello everyone and welcome to the coverage of the third day of the second Test between Australia and South Africa at the Bellerive Oval, Hobart. We lost an entire day to rain yesterday but weather looks fine for today, let's hope that it stays the same and we get all the overs in. Australia have a lot of catching up to do here and will hope to make the most of any assistance they can get.
Day 3... Session 1....

0835 IST - Rain has had the final say today. The groundsmen and the match officials had a chat and PLAY HAS BEEN ABANDONED FOR TODAY. Well, we have lost an entire day of play. Australia are not going to mind it at all. South Africa will feel they have enough time left in the game, despite the rain. Hopefully the weather clears up by tomorrow and we get some cricket. Play will start half an hour early from tomorrow with 98 overs each day. Do join us at 0430 IST for all the action on Day 3. Until then, it's goodbye and cheers!
0740 IST - The Lunch is done but not the rain. The weather is not showing any mercy. The wait prolongs. Stay tuned.
Day 2... Session 2...
0700 IST - I have an update for you. LUNCH has been taken. That's about it, sadly. It continues to pour in Hobart. Will we get any play today? Unlikely but let's keep our fingers crossed.
0555 IST - Not much to update about. The rain is steady now and the forecast post lunch is not good at all. Fingers crossed to get in some play.

0455 IST - Oh Rain! What a spoiler, not unexpected but still. The rain gods had relented yesterday to ensure we have a full day's play. Things are a bit different today. It is raining and the covers are firmly in place. Let's wait for it to clear.  Stay tuned for more updates.

The visitors are on top and will hope the pair of Quinton de Kock and Temba Bavuma can extend their dominance. There is rain forecast as well, let's hope it stays away and we get a full day. Australia have their backs to the wall and will be hoping to strike early to get back in the game. There is a lot at stake which assures plenty of action. Stay tuned.

Hello everyone and welcome to the coverage of the second day of the penultimate Test between Australia and South Africa at the Bellerive Oval, Hobart. The fortunes haven't changed for the hosts yet, the South African bowlers were once again too hot to handle for them. They got bundled out for a paltry score of 85 with Philander taking five. South Africa began well but they too lost as many as five wickets but still managed to sneak in a lead of 86 by stumps.
Day 2... Session 1...

There was not much play predicted for today and there isn't much for tomorrow either. But we got 87.5 overs today and would like to believe that rain will not play spoilsport tomorrow. Everyone would want to see this Test match going forward, given the pace it has developed today. Do join us tomorrow then, at 0500 IST (2330 GMT, previous day) for all the action from Day 2. You can also check out how England are faring against India in the first Test. Adios! Take Care!

One difference between the home side and South Africa has been partnerships. Australia barely got any while the tourists had three useful ones. First Amla and du Plessis added 30 for the 4th wicket, then we saw a 56-run stand for the 5th wicket between Amla and Bavuma and now, this stand between Bavuma and de Kock is already worth 39. The lead is worth 86 now and Australia will hope to try and keep it under 150. Even that would be enough for the Proteas, given the way they bowled in the first innings.

That ends a spectacular day's play. 15 wickets have fallen when not much play was predicted before the toss. In almost a you-blink-and-you'll-miss type moment, Australia got rolled over for 85 and were looking down and out, before an inspirational spell from Starc after Tea got Australia something to take from the day. Plenty of action happened in the final session as the Aussies got 5 Protea wickets.
Bowls it outside off on a length, Bavuma looks to play at it but then withdraws his bat in time to let it go. That ends an entertaining day. That's STUMPS, DAY 1!
Last ball of the day coming up. We've had 15 wickets falling. Starc goes round the wicket.
Bowls it short on middle and leg, de Kock gloves it down to fine leg for a single. de Kock's job's done for the day.
Similar length outside off, this time de Kock hops and plays it towards covers.
Back of a length outside off, de Kock ride the bounce and taps it towards point.
Banged in a touch short, Bavuma tucks it down to backward square leg for a single.
Fuller on off, de Kock leans across and works it wide of mid on. The fielder does well to keep it to a single.
Last over of the day coming up. Can Australia sneak a wicket here? Starc to bowl it, with two slips in place.
Comes forward and turns it towards the on side off his crease.
FOUR! Closing in on stumps but enough time for a class boundary! Landed outside off, Bavuma comes forward and gets over it and drives it through covers for a sublime boundary.
Pushes this one back to the bowler from his crease.
Shorter outside off, does not spin, Bavuma defends it.

Loud shout not given again! Shorter outside off, comes in, Bavuma is beaten by the turn and is rapped on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire says no. They contemplate about the review but do not go for it. That looked high too. Smith too felt it was a touch too high and the Ball Tracker confirms it.
Flatter on off, Bavuma comes forward and defends it.
Lyon comes back for an over before stumps.
Very full outside off, de Kock keeps it out in time.
Fuller outside off, de Kock looks to drive it but gets it off the inner half back down the wicket.
Bowls it on middle, Bavuma clips it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller outside off, left alone by Bavuma.

Loud shout but not given. Fuller outside off, Bavuma goes for the drive and seems to have missed it. There is a noise as Nevill collects the ball. There is an appeal but nothing from the umpire. Replays confirm there was no bat and the noise was of the bat hitting the ground.
Good length outside off, Bavuma stands tall and defends it.
Looks like Mennie is done for the day. He gets a tap on his back from a couple of his team-mates.
Another one going across de Kock who is happy to let it go through.
Good length outside off, de Kock gets in line and punches it down towards mid off from his crease.
Bowls it outside off, on a length, left alone.
Slanted across on a length, lef alone by de Kock.
Good length outside off, de Kock works it towards square leg off his crease.
Shorter outside off, de Kock works it towards mid on off his crease.
Hurls it on a good length outside off, Bavuma stands tall and defends it.
Outside off, Bavuma opens the face of the bat and gets it through covers. Warner gives it a chase and keeps them to a couple.
Yorker on off at 142.7 kph, Bavuma keeps it out with a full face of the bat.
Good length outside off, Bavuma taps it towards gully off his crease.
LOOSE from Bavuma! Fuller outside off, Bavuma goes for the drive but is beaten all ends up.
Starts off with a fuller one on middle, de Kock gets it through mid-wicket in time for a single.
Starc back on for a final burst today.
Outside off on a length, Bavuma takes the bottom half of the bat and defends it.
Angled on a length on middle, Bavuma clips it towards mid-wicket.
Outside off, de Kock gets it through extra covers for a single. Not sure if he wanted to play it through that region. It came off the leading edge.
FOUR! This time in complete control! Bowls it on off, de Kock presses forward and creams it down the ground through mid on for a boundary. Warner again gave chase there but could not stop the ball.

FOUR! In the air...but safe! Bowls it short on middle, de Kock goes for the pull but gets a top edge. The ball flies towards square leg. The fine leg is a bit wide and square leg cannot reach it. de Kock survives!
A touch short outside off, de Kock punches it to covers who dives to his right and stops it.
Good length outside off, left alone.
Good length outside off, Bavuma rides the bounce and taps it towards gully.
On a length on off, Bavuma clips it towards mid on off his crease.
Shorter length on middle, de Kock pulls it down to fine leg for a single.
Smith comes over to have a chat with his bowler.
de Kock gets across and defends it.

FOUR! Beautifully done! On a length on middle, de Kock pushes it back down the wicket through mid on. The fielder at mid on gives up the chase but not Warner who hares after it from mid off but the timing is too good and a boundary results.
de Kock gets across and clips it down to backward square leg for a single.
Outside off, on a length, de Kock pushes it back down the wicket.
Good length outside off, de Kock works it behind square on the leg side for a couple of runs.
Back of a length on middle, clipped through square leg for a single.
Good length outside off, left alone outside off.
Good length on off, Bavuma defends it from his crease.
Joe Mennie comes back on for a bowl.
Outside off, de Kock presses forward and places his cut towards point off his crease.
BEATEN! On a length outside off, de Kock looks to play at it but is beaten all ends up. That was inches past the outside edge.
Length again, de Kock taps it towards mid-wicket off his crease.
On a length outside off, de Kock gets an inside edge onto his pads.
On middle and leg, de Kock looks to clip it through but is hit on his pads. Mild appeal turned down as it was going down the leg side.
Fuller outside off, de Kock mistimes his push towards mid on.
Flatter on the pads again, Bavuma tucks it towards short leg again off his crease.
Flatter outside leg, Bavuma clips it towards short leg off his crease.
Floated on middle, Bavuma comes forward and defends it towards mid-wicket.
On the stumps, kept out by Bavuma.
Stays back and defends it.
Fuller outside off, de Kock drives it through mid off where Mennie stops it coming across from long off.
Outside off on a length, left alone.
Good length outside off, comes in, Bavuma is hit on his body as he fails to clip it. There was an inside edge there.
On a length on off, Bavuma defends it back.
Tucks it towards fine leg for a single. The umpire signals it a leg bye.
Bowls it on middle, de Kock looks to clip it through but is hit on his pads. There is an appeal but it looked high. Replays showed that it pitched outside leg  as well.
Fuller outside off, de Kock works it through mid-wicket off the inside edge for a single. Mennie misfields and allows the second.

Shorter outside off, de Kock looks to cut but gets an edge. Hazlewood ambles after it, the ball slows down towards the ropes. He puts in a dive as an afterthought and looks to have saved a run for his side.
Shorter outside off, de Kock waits for it and plays it through point for a couple of runs.
Stays back and works it towards backward square leg, short leg goes across and stops the ball.
Tossed up on off, de Kock comes forward and defends it.
Was that out? Nope. Shorter outside off, de Kock looks to cut it through but misses. Nevill drops the ball but there was no bat there.
Floated outside off, Bavuma sweeps it through square leg for a single.
Fuller outside off, de Kock drives it back to the bowler who mimes the throw.
On a length on off, de Kock comes forward and defends it.
Quinton de Kock walks in to bat. Can he play a counter-attacking knock here?

OUT! Hazlewood strikes again! Bowls it outside off, Amla has played these on-the-up shots all day without any footwork. This time he gets an outside edge and it flies through to the keeper for a good catch. That is a vital wicket for Australia, South Africa lead by 47 runs! The 56-run stand comes to an end.
Good length on off, Amla stays back and defends it.
Shorter outside off, Amla bottom edges his cut towards point.
Fuller and angling into the pads, Amla clips it through square leg for a couple of runs.
Hazlewood comes back on for a bowl.
Shorter outside off, punched off the back foot by Bavuma.
Bavuma comes forward and keeps it out.
Works it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Shorter on middle and leg, Amla looks to tuck but gets hit on his thigh pad. Warner at leg gully takes the catch and appeals but Lyon is walking back to his mark.
Tucks it trough the on side for a single.
Floated outside leg, Bavuma goes for the sweep but finds Starc at short fine leg.
Shorter length on the stumps, Amla lets it go over him.
50-run stand up between Amla and Bavuma!
Goes over the wicket, bowls it fuller on middle, Bavuma clips it through mid-wicket for three runs.
Sprays it full and wide outside off, asking Bavuma to go for it but the batsman is not interested.
Angled outside off on a fuller length, left alone.
FOUR! Crashed! Short and Starc gives width, Bavuma does not miss out and crashes it past point for a boundary. That is superbly hit!
Full and angling into the stumps, Bavuma keeps it out.
Goes back and turns it towards the on side off his crease.
Shorter on middle, Bavuma defends it back.

Some words being exchanged. There are few marks on the pitch towards the striker's end, Joe Burns from short leg reckons that Bavuma is making those when he shouldn't be. He is right too. The umpire comes in, so does Amla. It seems sorted though.
Landed on off, Bavuma comes forward and defends it.
Shorter on middle, whipped towards backward square leg for a single.
Bowls it on off, comes in a touch, Amla waits on his back foot and turns it towards short leg.
Floated outside off, Amla comes forward and defends it.
Back of a length outside off, Bavuma stands tall and defends it.
Good length outside off, Bavuma takes the bottom hand off the bat and defends it well towards point with an angled bat.
Spears it on the stumps, Bavuma presents the full face of the bat and defends it towards mid on.
FOUR!  Nicely done! Outside off, Bavuma defends it with soft hands past the diving fielder at third slip for a boundary.
Angles it outside off, coming in further, left alone by Bavuma.
Goes round the wicket, bowls it a touch short outside off, Bavuma raises his bat to let it go through.
Shorter on middle, worked behind square on the leg side by Bavuma for a single.
Amla clips this low full toss to mid on which is a bit deep and they scamper through for a single.
Turns this one towards mid-wicket off his crease.

Run out chance! Amla clips it towards short fine and takes off. Bavuma responds but Amla sends him back in time. Warner fires the throw as Bavuma dives to get back into his crease. Luckily for him, Warner missed the shy.
A touch short on the stumps, Amla keeps it out off the back foot.
FOUR! Nothing bowling! Floated on the pads, Amla clips it nicely through mid-wicket for a boundary. You cannot bowl there to Amla.
Slanted outside off, left alone by Bavuma.
FOUR! Fuller on the pads, Bavuma tickles it past the keeper for a boundary to the fine leg region. Easy pickings!
Good length on middle, Amla clips it towards square leg for a single. The umpire signals it a leg bye.
Slanted outside off, Amla is happy to let it go through.
In the gap! Fuller outside off, Amla flays it through covers for a couple of runs.
Fuller outside off, left alone by Amla.
Starc returns for a burst.
Nicely tossed up outside off, Bavuma reaches out for it and drives it through covers for a couple of runs.
Tough chance! Fuller on middle, Amla looks to clip but he gets it towards short leg. The ball lobs off Joe Burns' left leg and goes towards square leg for a single.
Floated outside off, Amla gets across and clips it towards mid-wicket.
Shorter outside off, Amla stays back and plays it back down the wicket.
Shorter again, Bavuma looks to tuck but misses. The ball runs down to the fine leg region. They cross for three byes.
Shorter on off, comes in, Bavuma works it towards short fine leg with a half-pull.
Drinks break!
Amla rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
On a good length and outside off, Amla punches it towards covers.
TB works it through mid-wicket for an easy single.
Touch short and outside off, Bavuma covers the line and defends.
Length ball on middle and leg, Amla gets back and flicks it between mid-wicket and mid on to come back for the third.
Angles in a back of a length ball from outside off, Amla swivels a bit to pull but misses it completely.
On middle and leg, Temba gets across and defends it into the ground.
Flighted ball around off, Bavuma defends it down watchfully.
Around middle, turning away, Bavuma gets back to play at it but fails to do so.

Dropped! Loopy ball around off, turning in as well. Bavuma looks to flick it across the line but fails to keep it down. It goes towards Burns at short leg who is a bit late to react as the ball goes off his right palm, hits the thigh and then dies down. Certainly a chance goes down abegging.
Tossed up ball around middle and off, Temba covers the line and defends it down gently.
Full and around middle and leg, nudged towards short mid-wicket.
Fullish on off, Amla decides to let that one go.
Length delivery on off, Amla hangs back and defends.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Back of a length delivery on off, punched off the back foot through covers for a single.
Beaten! On a length and outside off, Bavuma looks to defend but fails to get any bat on it. Mennie puts in an appeal but the umpire says not out.
Fuller in length and outside off, Temba defends it towards the off side.
Around middle and leg, flicked through square leg for a single.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Loopy ball around middle and off, Bavuma defends it watchfully.
FOUR! All timing! Tossed up ball around off, Bavuma nails the drive through covers for a boundary all the way.
Darted in around middle, worked towards mid-wicket.
Flatter one around middle, Bavuma gets across and defends.
Nathan Lyon into the attack now!
Bavuma flicks it through the on side for a single. SOUTH AFRICA TAKE LEAD!
Length ball on off, TB fails to get bat on ball.
Gets behind the line and defends it down.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.

Brilliant effort from Smith! Fuller in length on off, moves away a touch. Amla looks to defend but gets a thick outside edge past third slip. Smith from second slip gives it a chase and does well to scoop the ball back in play. They refer it upstairs to see if Smith made contact with the rope when the ball was in his hand. He didn't, three runs taken. Scores are level now.
Ripper! On a length and scoots through the surface around off. That's the line these Aussies got to bowl. Amla looks to defend but misses as the ball goes just past the outside edge to the keeper.
Fuller in length on off, Amla pushes it uppishly towards covers for a single to keep strike.
Leg bye! Angles it on the pads, Bavuma goes for the flick but misses. The ball goes off the pads towards square leg. A leg bye is taken.
On a good length and pitched outside off. Bavuma looks to defend but misses as the ball goes through to the keeper.
Fuller on off, Bavuma makes an easy leave to the keeper.
On a length and outside off, TB hangs back in defense.
Good length ball on middle, Temba comes a step forward and defends.
On a length and outside off, Amla pokes at it but gets a thick outside edge which falls short of the man at gully.
FOUR! Shot, Hashim! Fuller and in the channel on off, Amla transfers his weight on the front foot and drills it past covers for a boundary all the way.
Outside off, Amla is happy to let it go.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Flicked towards the leg side for nothing.

Chance of a run out! Length ball on middle and leg, Amla works it towards square leg and sets off. Bavuma sends him back as Burns gets to the ball and has a shy at the striker's end. He misses as Amla dives to get back in.
On a length and nipping back in sharply again. Bavuma looks to defend but misses as the ball goes off the pads towards the off side. An appeal is made but the height seemed to be an issue there.
Temba Bavuma is the new man in.

OUT! The decisions stays as it is! Josh Hazlewood strikes! He deserved this wicket, didn't he? Hurls it on off, gets it to nip back in as du Plessis is late to bring his bat down. Is hit on the pads and Josh appeals for an LBW. Umpire Kettleborough raises his finger but Faf takes the review straightaway. Replays show it's pitched in line and was going on to hit the leg stump. Faf has to go and Australia are coming back in the game. South Africa still trail by 9 runs!
Faf du Plessis is given out LBW but he opts for the review. Looks really close, this. He reckons it is going down leg.
On a length and outside off, du Plessis shoulders his arms.
Length ball on middle and leg, Amla gets back and flicks it through wide mid on for three.
Good length ball on middle, defended off the back foot.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for South Africa! On a length and served on off, Amla makes some room and caresses it through covers. Timed it well and got the desired result.

FOUR! Off the meat of the bat! Mennie keeps it nice and full on off, little bit of width on offer as well. du Plessis leans into it and drives it beautifully through covers to send it across the rope.
Short on off, Faf tucks it towards the leg side.
Good length ball on off, du Plessis lifts his bat and lets it go.
This one holds its line, the SA skipper leaves it alone.
Fuller on the pads, flicked towards the leg side.
Fuller in length and straightens a bit after pitching. du Plessis comes forward to defend but is beaten all ends up.
Joe Mennie comes back on for a bowl.
Fuller in length and angled on the pads, flicked through square leg. The fielder comes across to his left and does well to keep them down to a couple.
Good length ball on off, Amla leaves it alone.
FOUR! Pulled away in style! Back of a length delivery on middle, Amla swivels in the crease and pulls it firmly through square leg for a boundary. Really well played, that.
Touch full and outside off, Hashim defends it down solidly.
Pitches it on off, pushed towards mid off.
Fuller on the stumps, Amla drives it past the non-striker down the ground towards long on for a couple.
Length delivery outside off, Faf shoulders his arms to that one.
Fuller in length and outside off, jammed out on the off side.
Good length ball on middle, defended off the back foot.
In the channel outside off, it's been left alone.
Fuller in length and outside off, du Plessis gets forward and drives it through covers for a couple.
Back of a length ball on off, tapped towards covers from within the crease. Starc oversteps and the umpire stretches his right hand out.
Starc bangs in short on off, Faf ducks under it.
That's three in a row! Outside off, Amla doesn't even bother looking at that one.
Length ball on off, Amla gives some work to Nevill has he lets it go.
In the corridor outside off, Hashim lifts his bat and allows it to go through.
On a good length and outside off, Hashim pushes it towards point off the back foot.
Amla gets forward, keeps his bat close to pad and defends it down the ground.
FOUR! Glorious! Fuller in length and outside off, Amla makes room and drives it on the up through covers. Through the gap and away she goes for a boundary. Josh shares a wry smile at Amla.
Too full and outside off, it's left alone yet again.
On a length and outside off, du Plessis makes an easy leave to the keeper.
Lovely shot! Fuller in length on off, Amla lunges forward and drives it through covers. Warner gives it a chase, slides and does well to scoop the ball back in play. Three runs taken.
Back of a length ball on middle, Amla hops and defends it into the ground.
Comes in from outside off, Amla covers the line and defends it down gently.
Length ball, slanting across on off. Amla nicely shoulders his arms to that one.
Fuller in length and outside off, driven towards the man at mid off.
On a good length and moves away again, du Plessis doesn't even look at it.
In the channel outside off, lovely away swing but du Plessis is happy to leave it alone.
On a length and angling in, Faf looks to defend but gets an inside edge towards short leg.
Fuller in length and coming back in, the Protea skipper offers a solid front foot defense.
On a length and outside off, Faf makes a brave leave to the keeper.
Fuller on middle, clipped towards the man at mid on for a single.
Fuller and curling back in, du Plessis digs it out.
Faf du Plessis walks in next, replacing Duminy!

OUT! Edged and it's gone! Mitchell Starc is breathing fire here! Boy, someone tell me what he had during the tea break? He hurls it on a fuller length and straightens a shade after pitching. Duminy goes for the drive but gets a thick outside edge towards second slip where Smith takes a regulation catch. Australia have brought life back in the game.
Angles it on middle, Duminy looks to clip it across the line but misses and is hit on the pads.
Sprays it on the pads, too easy for Amla tucks it towards fine leg for an eay single.
On a length and angling in on the pads, Duminy clips it behind square on the leg side for a single to get off the mark.
Full and swinging away after pitching, Amla has got nothing to do with that one.
Fuller and curling back in sharply, Amla comes on the front foot and drives it towards mid off.
On a good length and outside off, the batsman defends it from within the crease.
In the channel outside off, HA lifts his bat and lets it go through.
Fuller in length and outside off, Hashim prods forward and defends it down gently.
Angles in a length ball on off, Amla comes forward and then shoulders his arms to that one.
Josh Hazlewood to bowl from the other end.

Loud appeal for an lbw but not given! Hurls it on a length on off and middle, Duminy looks to defend but is hit on his pads. Starc and the players appeal long and hard but nothing from the umpire. No harm done. They do not for the review.
JP Duminy is the new man in.

OUT! STARC IS ON THE CHARGE! Bowls it fuller outside off, Cook goes for the drive from his crease without any footwork. The ball takes the edge and flies through to the keeper for a good catch. Starc is pumped up and why not. Ideal start for Australia! South Africa still trail by 41!
Too full outside off, Amla squeezes it past point for a single to get off the mark.
Good length outside off, Amla gets across and defends it back down the wicket.
Fuller on middle, Amla keeps it out in time.
Hashim Amla is the new man in.

OUT! STARC STRIKES! Bowls it full on middle and leg, Elgar looks to clip it but is hit on the back leg. The players go up in an appeal and the umpire raises his finger. That is an ideal start for Australia. Elgar ponders about the review but does not take it. The Ball Tracker shows it was hitting leg stump.
The players are back on the field. STEPHEN COOK and DEAN ELGAR to continue batting. Starc to bowl.
DAY 1... SESSION 3...

The Proteas have reached the same score - 43 - which the Aussies were at Lunch. The only difference being that the hosts were 6 down and the visitors have all their wickets intact. The hosts look down and out at the moment and need something inspirational to turn things their way, else, this match could go out of hand tonight itself. Join us back at 1000 IST (0430 GMT) for the final session.

Australia were not good at all with the bat and now they have not been attacking enough with the ball. They leaked runs with the new ball but then have managed to pull things back a bit towards the latter half of the session. But they have not looked even half as menacing as even Kyle Abbott, let alone Vernon Philander.

A comfortable session for the Proteas. Got the Aussies out nice and early and have negotiated the remaining part without losing a wicket. Yes, there has been the odd play and a miss but those have been far and few in between.
Fuller outside off, Elgar drives it through covers where Voges misfields and allows a single, tells you how the day has been for Australia so far. That's TEA, DAY 1!
A shorter one outside off, Elgar is careful and plays it towards backward point off his crease.
Floated outside off, Elgar comes forward and lets it go through.
Shorter outside off, Elgar is beaten by the turn on that one.
Tossed up outside off, Elgar pushes it towards covers off his crease.
Floated outside off, Elgar drives it nicely to mid off from his crease.
Nathan Lyon comes into the attack.
Fuller on off, Elgar comes forward and drives it through mid off. Warner runs after it from mid off and keeps them to three.
Fuller outside off, Elgar pushes it towards covers off his crease.
Good length outside off, Elgar comes forward and plays it towards covers.
Shorter length outside off, Elgar spots it early and gets out of the way in time.
Fuller outside off, Elgar punches it towards covers.
Good length outside off, Elgar pushes it towards covers off his crease.
Angled on a length on off, Cook defends it back down the wicket.
On a length outside off, Cook comes forward and defends it.
Back of a length outside off, Cook defends it from his crease.
Fuller length on off, Cook clips it towards mid on off the inner half of the bat.
Tucks it down to fine leg for a single.

Bowls it on middle and leg, Cook again gets into a tangle and fends it down to short fine leg. That looked to be height and also going down leg since Cook was on the move and also hopping a touch. They scamper through for a leg bye.
Back of a length outside off, Elgar defends it back down the wicket.
Fuller outside off, Elgar comes forward and defends it.
Spears it full and on off, Elgar keeps it out in time towards mid on.
Lyon is warming up.
Good length on off, Elgar covers the line and defends it.
On a length outside off, Elgar punches it on the up through extra cover for a couple.
Bowls it outside off, Elgar comes forward and defends it back down the wicket.
Starc returns for a bowl.
BEATEN! Bowls it outside off, Cook again plays at it from his crease and is beaten. Australia need to keep bowling more such deliveries to induce the false stroke.
On the pads, Elgar clips it down to the fine leg region for a single.
Good length outside off, Elgar takes the bottom hand of that one and defends it towards the on side.
On a length on middle, Elgar looks to clip it through but gets squared up yet keeps it out.
Goes round the wicket, bowls it on a length, Elgar looks to play at it but is beaten.
Fuller on middle, Cook clips it towards wide mid on from his crease. Ferguson again does well going to his right from mid on and stopping that one from going through. A run taken.
Fuller outside off, Elgar gets an inside edge onto his pads. He looks to be in some pain but is fine.
Good length on off and middle, Elgar gets in line and defends it.
Fuller outside off, Elgar pushes it towards extra cover from his crease.
Fuller outside off, Elgar looks to defend but gets it off the inner half towards mid-wicket.
On a length on off, Elgar keeps it out from his crease.
Length ball on off, Elgar clips it towards mid-wicket off his crease.
Angled on a length just outside off, Cook takes the bottom hand off the bat and defends it towards mid on.
Outside off on a length, left alone.
Angled on a fuller length on middle, Cook presents the full face of the bat and defends it.
Fuller on middle, Cook covers the line and clips it through mid-wicket. Burns runs after it, slides and stops the ball before it crosses the ropes. Two runs taken.
Cook plays at this one nicely and pushes it into the gaps with an open face of the bat and a hop.
Angled outside off on a length, Cook defends it towards covers. That was played very awkwardly.
Fuller outside off, Elgar is right forward and pushes it to covers.
Bowls it on a length, comes in with the angle, pitches and goes away a touch, Elgar plays it towards covers.
In the same zone and this time Elgar knows he needs not play at that and lets it go. Now can Hazlewood bring one back into him to create a doubt in his mind?
BEATEN! Hurls it on a fuller length outside off, Elgar plays at it from his crease and is beaten by the late away movement. Need more of these, Australia.
Goes round the wicket and bowls it fuller outside off, Elgar times his drive nicely towards covers.
Slanted across on a length outside off, left alone by Elgar.
Bowls it outside off, on a length, Cook feels for it and plays but is beaten all ends up. That has not happened a lot, in this innings - A play and a miss!
Cook strides forward and defends it towards covers.
Good length on off, Elgar tucks it towards square leg for a single.
Good length on middle, Cook waits for it and clips it towards Burns at mid-wicket. He waits to ensure it is wide enough and then goes for the run. Burns has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses.
Slants this one on the pads, Cook fails to clip it away. Mild appeal turned down.
Fuller outside off, Elgar comes forward and drives it back down the wicket. The timing is good and they get a three runs. It was Elgar who pushed Cook for the third.
Fuller outside off, Cook drives it back down the wicket off the inner half.

That's more like it! Bowls it on a length on off, comes in, Cook is beaten by the movement and is hit on his thigh pad as the ball bounces a touch more. Loud appeal from the players but that was always too high.
Good length outside off, Cook is happy to leave it. Australia need to make them play and not leave easily. The lines are wrong, they need to hit the top of off here, they have been far too wide.
Fuller outside off, Cook presses forward and drives it towards covers. He looks for a single but it is not on.
Good length outside off, left alone by Cook.
Bowls it outside off, on a fuller length, Cook is not interested.
Slanted across outside off, left alone by Elgar.
Fuller on middle, Elgar clips it through square leg. The outfield is slow and it allows Hazlewood who gets across from deep fine leg. A couple taken.
Fuller on off, Elgar looks to clip it through but gets it back down the wicket. Mennie gets a boot to it in his followthrough and parries it towards mid off who covers it well.
On off, Elgar comes forward and pushes it to covers.
Slanted across on a length, on off, Elgar plays at it with the bat that comes across and hence is beaten.
Bowls it on the pads, Elgar looks to clip but gets it off the pads to fine leg for a couple of leg byes.
Angled on a fuller length on middle, Cook clips it through mid-wicket. Ferguson again is the one chasing and keeps them to a couple despite the wild throw.
Fuller outside off, comes in, Cook covers the line and pushes it towards mid on.
Good length outside off, Cook comes forward and pushes it to covers.
Fuller outside off, Cook lets it go through safely.
Outside off on a length, comes in, Cook allows it to come to him and defends it from his crease.
On a length on middle, Cook looks to work it through mid-wicket but gets a leading edge back towards the bowler.
Change of ends for Hazlewood.

Hurls it on a very full length on middle, Cook gets across and clips it through mid-wicket. Ferguson gives it a chase and does well to keep them to three. This is a good start for Cook. Decent first over from Mennie in Test cricket.
Fuller on off, Elgar looks to work it through the on side but gets it off the inner half to fine leg for a run.
Back of a length on off, Elgar defends it back down the wicket.
Pitched up on middle, Elgar looks to defend but gets it off the outer half towards covers.
Pushes this one towards mid off and sets off for a quick single. There is a shy at the non-striker's end but no harm done.
Fuller outside off, Cook drives it to covers.
Joe Mennie to bowl from the other end.
Bowls it very full on off, Elgar brings his bat down in time to keep it out. Starc wants to appeal for some reason though.
Good length on middle, Elgar clips it towards mid-wicket off his crease.
Fuller outside off, Elgar pushes it towards covers.
Fuller on middle and leg, Cook clips it through wide mid on. Mennie looks to give it a chase from mid on and does well to save a run for his side with a fine slide at the fence.
Slanted outside off, left alone outside off.
Back of a length on off, Cook is squared up a touch, gets it towards covers.
Good length outside off, Elgar comes forward and defends it.
On a length outside off, Elgar comes forward and defends it.
Full outside off, Elgar drives it towards mid off from his crease.
Slanted outside off, on a length, Elgar raises his bat and lets it go through.
Fuller outside off, Elgar comes forward and defends it towards covers.
Angled on a good length outside off, Elgar looks to defend but gets it off the inside edge towards the on side.
Fuller outside off, Cook is happy to let it go through.
On a length, Cook comes forward and defends it.

FOUR! Nicely timed! Fuller on middle, Cook stays in his crease and clips it through mid-wicket. Burns gives it a chase from square leg, dives near the ropes but take the ball with him. Cook is not quite playing them as he should but he is battling it out there.
Fuller outside off, Cook is half forward and he gets an inside edge towards mid-wicket.
Bowls it on middle, Cook gets in line and defends it back down the wicket.
Angled on a length outside off, Cook raises his bat and lets it go through.
Fuller outside off, Cook drives it nicely towards wide mid off where Warner gets across in time and keeps them to a single.
Angled on a length on off, Cook keeps it out in time.
FOUR! EDGED! Outside off on a length, Cook plays at it from his crease. The ball flies past the third slip fielder for a boundary. Streaky start.
Fuller on off, comes in, Cook pushes it back down the wicket.
Angled on a length on middle, Cook tucks it towards mid-wicket off his crease.
Bowls it outside off on a length, left alone by Cook.
Josh Hazlewood is the bowler from the other end.
Low full toss outside off, Elgar reaches out for it and squeezes it past gully for a couple of runs. He too gets off the mark.
Good length outside off, Elgar taps it towards the on side off his crease.
BEATEN! Bowls it outside off, Elgar looks to play at it but is beaten by the away movement.
Fuller outside off, Elgar keeps it out towards covers off his crease.
Bowls it outside off, on a length, left alone by Elgar.
Off the mark! Fuller outside off, Cook pushes it in the gap at covers for a single to get off the mark.
